Priya Nair: Heads up - we're getting reports of delayed onboarding confirmations and partial search results for EU trial customers started overnight. I pulled a list of affected accounts (~95) and want to coordinate customer comms + credits.

Ethan Brooks: We're seeing a consumer lag on the index-writer service; root cause looks like retry amplification after a brief downstream 503 burst. Engineers applied a temporary retry cap at 1755680000 and increased parallel consumers. Expect queue to drain in ~30-50m.

Marco Rossi: Just saw DeployBot show an emergency config change applied (reducing retry attempts). Monitoring shows error rate dropping. Will roll a GC tuning change if the drain stalls.

Priya Nair: Draft message for customers below. Keep it short and actionable. We want to reassure and offer a standardized credit for trials.

Priya Nair: "
Hello — we9re sorry for the interruption. Some customers in the EU are experiencing slower onboarding and partial search results while we clear an indexing backlog. Our engineers have applied mitigations and we expect full service to return within 1 hour.

What we9re doing: patched retry behavior and increased processing capacity; we9re monitoring the queue and will perform any necessary backfills.

If you were affected: we9ll reach out with next steps and a $200 account credit for impacted trials (auto-applied). Book a 1:1 if you need prioritized assistance: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We apologize and will follow up with a detailed RCA.

 Redwood Inference Support
"

Ethan Brooks: Good. Two operational notes: 1) do not promise manual backfills for all accounts; offer case-by-case for high-touch. 2) Flag renewal-risk customers ($15k+ ARR) for AE outreach; I can share the filtered list.

Priya Nair: Agreed. Standard credit $200 for trials <6 months. High-touch/enterprise — custom remediation. I'll prepare a short FAQ with: how we9ll notify when resolved, how credits are issued, and how to request a 1:1.

Marco Rossi: Deploy events: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-cap-202  success  1755680055. Queue drain: 50% in 20m, 85% in 40m. Paused retries still holding.

AlertBot: Incident INC-4762 created  status: mitigated  1755680100

Priya Nair: Sending first wave to affected trials now (email + in-app). Subject: "Update: onboarding slowdown affecting some EU trials". Copy includes booking link and credit notice.

Ethan Brooks: I'll DM the list of renewal-risk tenants to Priya + AEs. Also adding GC tuning to next patch cycle to avoid recurrence.

Marco Rossi: Quick RCA draft bullet: immediate trigger = downstream 503 burst; amplification = aggressive retry settings + brief GC pause on a subset of indexers. Remediations = retry caps, consumer scaling, GC/heap adjustments, and add alerting on consumer lag thresholds. We'll finalize full RCA within 24h.

Priya Nair: Timeline: 1) send customer note (done) 2) update status page when drain hits 100% 3) post full RCA + renewal-risk comms within 24h 4) credits applied + feedback survey within 48h.

CS Bot: Noted  affected_count=95  office hours: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

Marco Rossi: Queue drained fully at 1755682200. No data loss detected.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll coordinate credits issuance and work with AEs on proactive outreach for renewal-risk accounts. Will post engagement metrics and survey responses in this thread. :pray:
